name: Explorer Kit
short_effect: Allows visiting the Underground.
effect: Sends the trainer to the Underground. Only usable outside.

name: Loot Sack
short_effect: Carries coal mine loot.
effect: Unused.
flavor_text: A sturdy, spacious bag that is used to carry any treasures or loot obtained in the coal mine.

name: Rule Book
short_effect: List of battle types and their rules.
effect: Unused.
flavor_text: It lists the rules for holding battles. For Link Battles, you may choose which set of rules you wish to use.

name: Poké Radar
short_effect: Use to track down rare or shiny Pokémon. 50 steps to recharge.
effect: Designates several nearby patches of grass as containing Pokémon, some of which may be special radar-only Pokémon. Successive uses in a certain way create chains of encounters with the same species; longer chains increase the chance that a shiny Pokémon of that species will appear.
flavor_text: A tool that can search out Pokémon that are hiding in the tall grass. Its battery is recharged as you walk.

name: Point Card
short_effect: Keeps count of Battle Points earned.
effect: Tracks Battle Points.
flavor_text: A card that lists how many Battle Points you have earned.

name: Journal
short_effect: Records prior significant activities the player took.
effect: Records some of the trainer's activities for the day.
flavor_text: A notebook that keeps a record of your adventure so far.

name: Seal Case
short_effect: Stores Seals that can be applied to Poké Ball capsules.
effect: Contains Seals used for decorating Pokéballs.
flavor_text: A case for storing Seals that can be applied to the exteriors of Poké Balls.

name: Fashion Case
short_effect: Holds Pokémon Accessories for use in Contests.
effect: Contains Pokémon Accessories.
flavor_text: A wondrous, pretty case to store lots of colorful Props for your Pokémon to wear in a musical.

name: Seal Bag
short_effect: Holds ten Seals for Poké Balls.
effect: Unused.
flavor_text: A tiny bag that can hold 10 Seals for decorating Poké Balls.

name: Pal Pad
short_effect: Use to record Friend Codes and check your own.
effect: Contains friend codes for up to 32 other players, as well as their sprite, gender, and basic statistics for those that have been seen on WFC.
flavor_text: A convenient notepad that is used to register your friends and keep a record of your gameplay.

name: Works Key
short_effect: Grants access to Valley Windworks.
effect: Opens the front door of the Valley Windworks. Reusable.
flavor_text: A large key for operating the doors of the Valley Windworks in the canyon. It was held by a Team Galactic Grunt.

name: Old Charm
short_effect: Trade to Cynthia's grandmother in Celestic Town for HM04 (Surf).
effect: Given to Cynthia's grandmother to get the Surf HM.
flavor_text: An ancient good-luck charm made of Pokémon bones to be taken to the elder of Celestic Town.

name: Galactic Key
short_effect: Grants access to Galactic HQ in Veilstone City.
effect: Grants access to Galactic HQ in Veilstone City.
flavor_text: A card key for disengaging the security systems in the Galactic HQ. Losing it can result in punishment, apparently.

name: Red Chain
short_effect: Used to bind Palkia and Dialga.
effect: Unused.
flavor_text: A mythical chain that is said to bind the Legendary Pokémon that created the Sinnoh region.

name: Town Map
short_effect: Use to see the overworld map.
effect: Displays a map of the region including the trainer's position, location names, visited towns, gym locations, and where the trainer has been walking recently.
flavor_text: A very convenient map that can be viewed anytime. It even shows you your present location in the region.

name: Vs. Seeker
short_effect: Allows rebattling of on-screen trainers. 100 steps to recharge.
effect: Reveals trainers who want a rematch, by showing !! over their heads. Each use drains the battery; requires 100 steps to charge.
flavor_text: A device that indicates Trainers who want to battle. Its battery charges while you walk.

name: Coin Case
short_effect: Holds coins for the Game Corner.
effect: Contains the Coins used by the Game Corner, to a maximum of 50,000.
flavor_text: A case for holding coins obtained at the Game Corner. It can hold up to 50,000 coins.

name: Old Rod
short_effect: Used to catch Pokémon in bodies of water.
effect: Used to find Pokémon on the Old Rod list for an area, which are generally Magikarp or similar.
flavor_text: An old and beat-up fishing rod. Use it at bodies of water to fish for Pokémon.

name: Good Rod
short_effect: Used to catch Pokémon in bodies of water.
effect: Used to find Pokémon on the Good Rod list for an area, which are generally mediocre.
flavor_text: A new, good-quality fishing rod. Use it at bodies of water to fish for Pokémon.

name: Super Rod
short_effect: Used to catch Pokémon in bodies of water.
effect: Used to find Pokémon on the Super Rod list for an area, which are generally the best available there.
flavor_text: An awesome, high-spec fishing rod. Use it at bodies of water to fish for Pokémon.

name: Sprayduck
short_effect: Used to water berries.
effect: Waters Berry plants.
flavor_text: A watering can shaped like a Psyduck. It helps promote the healthy growth of any Berries planted in good, soft soil.

name: Poffin Case
short_effect: Holds Poffins.
effect: Contains up to 100 Poffins.
flavor_text: A case for storing Poffins cooked from Berries.

name: Bicycle
short_effect: Use for fast transit.
effect: Increases movement speed outside or in caves. In high gear, allows the trainer to hop over some rocks and ascend muddy slopes.
flavor_text: A folding Bicycle that enables a rider to get around much faster than a pair of Running Shoes will allow.

name: Suite Key
short_effect: Opens a locked building in the Lakeside Resort.
effect: Opens the locked building in the lakeside resort.
flavor_text: A key to one of the suites at a certain luxury hotel by a lake. For some odd reason, it often disappears.

name: Oak's Letter
short_effect: Allows access to Seabreak path, Flower Paradise, and Shaymin.
effect: Grants access to Flower Paradise and Shaymin.
flavor_text: A letter from Professor Oak. Written in it is a request for you to go to Route 224.

name: Lunar Wing
short_effect: Cures sailor's son of nightmares in Canalave City.
effect: Cures the sailor's son of his nightmares; no reward, only a side effect of seeing Cresselia.
flavor_text: A feather that glows like the moon. It's said to possess the power to dispel nightmares.

name: Member Card
short_effect: Allows access to Newmoon Island and Darkrai.
effect: Provides access to Newmoon Island and Darkrai.
flavor_text: A card needed for entering the inn in Canalave City. Oddly, the last date marked on it was 50 years ago.

name: Azure Flute
short_effect: Allows entry into the Hall of Origin. Unreleased.
flavor_text: A flute that puts out echoing sounds that do not seem to be of this world. No one knows who made it or when.

name: S.S. Ticket
short_effect: Ticket for a ship. (RSE: S.S. Tidal LF: S.S. Anne HG: S.S. Aqua)
effect: Allows passage on a ferry. The same item is used for different ferries between different games.
flavor_text: A ticket required for sailing on the high-speed ferry S.S. Aqua. It has a drawing of a ship on it.

name: Contest Pass
short_effect: Allows participation in Pokémon Contests.
effect: Allows the trainer to enter Contests.
flavor_text: A pass required for entering Pokémon Contests. It has a drawing of an award ribbon on its front.

name: Magma Stone
short_effect: Magma is sealed inside.
effect: Causes Heatran to appear at Reversal Mountain. Unused prior to Black and White 2.
flavor_text: A stone formed by boulders melting in intensely hot magma, then hardening. Magma remains sealed inside it.

name: Parcel
short_effect: Given to the trainer's rival in Jubilife City. Contains Town Maps.
effect: Given to the trainer's rival in Jubilife City. Contains two Town Maps, one of which is given to the trainer upon delivery.
flavor_text: A parcel entrusted into your care. You're supposed to deliver it to your childhood friend who left Twinleaf Town.

name: Coupon 1
short_effect: The first of three tickets used to obtain a Pokétch.
effect: One of three coupons needed to receive a Pokétch.
flavor_text: A coupon to be exchanged for a Pokémon Watch— Pokétch for short. Three coupons are needed.

name: Coupon 2
short_effect: The second of three tickets used to obtain a Pokétch.
effect: One of three coupons needed to receive a Pokétch.
flavor_text: A coupon to be exchanged for a Pokémon Watch— Pokétch for short. Three coupons are needed.

name: Coupon 3
short_effect: The last of three tickets used to obtain a Pokétch.
effect: One of three coupons needed to receive a Pokétch.
flavor_text: A coupon to be exchanged for a Pokémon Watch— Pokétch for short. Three coupons are needed.

name: Storage Key
short_effect: Grants access to the Team Galactic warehouse in Veilstone City.
effect: Grants access to the Team Galactic warehouse in Veilstone City.
flavor_text: The key to Team Galactic's sinister warehouse located at the edge of Veilstone City.

name: Secret Potion
short_effect: Used to heal the Ampharos at the top of Olivine Lighthouse.
effect: Required to cure the Psyducks blocking Route 210 of their chronic headaches.
flavor_text: A fantastic medicine dispensed by the pharmacy in Cianwood City. It fully heals a Pokémon of any ailment.

name: Griseous Orb
short_effect: Boosts the damage from Giratina's Dragon-type and Ghost-type moves by 20%, and transforms it into Origin Forme.
effect: Held by Giratina : Holder's Dragon and Ghost moves have 1.2× their base power. Holder is in Origin Forme. This item cannot be held by any Pokémon but Giratina. When you enter the Union Room or connect to Wi-Fi, this item returns to your bag.
flavor_text: A shining gem to be held by Giratina. It boosts the power of Giratina's Dragon- and Ghost-type moves.

name: Vs. Recorder
short_effect: Records wireless, Wi-Fi, or Battle Frontier battles, and stores points.
effect: Optionally records wireless, Wi-Fi, and Battle Frontier battles. Tracks Battle Points earned in the Battle Frontier, and stores commemorative prints.
flavor_text: An amazing device that can record a battle between friends or the battles at certain special battle facilities.

name: Gracidea
short_effect: Changes an unfrozen Shaymin to Sky Forme in the day.
effect: Used by trainer on a Shaymin : Changes the target Shaymin from Land Forme to Sky Forme. This item cannot be used on a frozen Shaymin or at night. Sky Forme Shaymin will revert to Land Forme overnight, when frozen, and upon entering a link battle. This item must be used again to change it back.
flavor_text: A flower sometimes bundled into a bouquet to be given as an expression of gratitude on special occasions, such as birthdays and anniversaries.

name: Secret Key
short_effect: Gen IV: The key to Rotom's appliance room. Gen III: The key to Cinnabar Gym.
effect: Used by trainer in the Galactic Eterna Building, on the ground floor, to the left of the TV : Unlocks the secret Rotom room, in which there are five appliances which can change Rotom's form.
flavor_text: A high-tech key that has to be used at a specific location. It emits a special electronic signal to open a door.

name: Apricorn Box
short_effect: Holds Apricorns.
effect: Stores Apricorns.
flavor_text: A handy box where you can store up to 99 of each kind of Apricorn.

name: Berry Pots
short_effect: Allows portable berry growing.
effect: Contains four portable pots of soil suitable for growing berries.
flavor_text: Portable containers that allow you to easily cultivate Berries anywhere and anytime.

name: Squirt Bottle
short_effect: Use on Sudowoodo blocking the path on Route 36. Also waters berries.
effect: Required to water berries within the Berry Pots. Required to battle the Sudowoodo on Route 36. This item cannot be directly used from the bag.
flavor_text: A bottle used for watering plants in the Berry Pots.

name: Lure Ball
short_effect: 3× effectiveness while fishing. Made from Blu Apricorn.
effect: Used by trainer in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost. If the wild Pokémon was encountered by fishing, the wild Pokémon's catch rate is 3× normal.
flavor_text: A somewhat different Poké Ball that is more effective when catching Pokémon in or on the water.

name: Level Ball
short_effect: Success rate based off of fraction target Pokémon is of user's Pokémon. Made from Red Apricorn.
effect: Used by trainer in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost. If the trainer's Pokémon's level is higher than: * four times the wild Pokémon's, the wild Pokémon's catch rate is 8× normal. * than twice the wild Pokémon's, the wild Pokémon's catch rate is 4× normal. * the wild Pokémon's, the wild Pokémon's catch rate is 2× normal.
flavor_text: A somewhat different Poké Ball that becomes more effective the lower the level of the Pokémon compared to your own Pokémon.

name: Moon Ball
short_effect: 4× effectiveness on familes of Pokémon with a Moon Stone evolution. Made from Ylw Apricorn.
effect: Used by trainer in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost. If the wild Pokémon is a Clefairy, Nidoran♂, Nidoran♀, Jigglypuff, Skitty, or any evolution thereof, the wild Pokémon has 4× its catch rate.
flavor_text: A somewhat different Poké Ball that is more effective when catching Pokémon that can be evolved using a Moon Stone.

name: Heavy Ball
short_effect: Has flat bonus or penalty to catch rate depending on weight class of target. Made from Blk Apricorn.
effect: Used by a trainer in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost. If the wild Pokémon weighs: * 409.6 kg (903.0 lb) or more, its catch rate is 40 more than normal. * 307.2 kg (677.3 lb) or more, its catch rate is 30 more than normal. * 204.8 kg (451.5 lb) or more, its catch rate is 20 more than normal. * less than 204.8 kg (451.5 lb), its catch rate is 20 less than normal.
flavor_text: A Poké Ball that is better than usual at catching very heavy Pokémon.

name: Fast Ball
short_effect: 4× effectiveness on Pokémon with 100 or greater base speed. (Gen II: Roaming or Fleeing Pokémon). Made from Wht Apricorn.
effect: Used by a trainer in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost. : If the wild Pokémon's base speed is 100 or more, its catch rate is 4× normal.
flavor_text: A somewhat different Poké Ball that is more effective when catching Pokémon that are usually very quick to run away.

name: Friend Ball
short_effect: Caught Pokémon start with 200 happiness. Made from Grn Apricorn.
effect: Used by a trainer in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost. If caught, the wild Pokémon's happiness starts at 200.
flavor_text: A somewhat different Poké Ball that makes a wild Pokémon more friendly toward you immediately after it's caught.

name: Love Ball
short_effect: 8× effectiveness on opposite sex, same species targets of the Active Pokémon. Made from Pnk Apricorn.
effect: Used by a trainer in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost. If the trainer's Pokémon and wild Pokémon are of the same species but opposite genders, the wild Pokémon's catch rate is 8× normal.
flavor_text: A somewhat different Poké Ball that is more effective when catching Pokémon of the opposite gender to your own Pokémon.

name: Park Ball
short_effect: Catches Pokémon in the Pal Park every time.
effect: Used by a trainer in battle : Catches a wild Pokémon. This item can only be used in Pal Park.
flavor_text: A special Poké Ball used in the Pal Park.

name: Sport Ball
short_effect: Tries to catch a Pokémon in the Bug-Catching contest in National Park. (Gen II: Park Ball)
effect: Used by a trainer in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon. The wild Pokémon's catch rate is 1.5× normal.
flavor_text: A special Poké Ball that was used during the Bug-Catching Contest in the Johto region.

name: Red Apricorn
short_effect: Used to make a Level Ball.
effect: May be given to Kurt in Azalea Town to produce a Level Ball.
flavor_text: A red Apricorn. It has a pungent scent that assails the nostrils.

name: Blue Apricorn
short_effect: Used to make a Lure Ball.
effect: May be given to Kurt in Azalea Town to produce a Lure Ball.

name: Endorsement
flavor_text: A letter of recommendation that you'll need in order to participate in the Gym Challenge.

name: Pokémon Box Link
flavor_text: A device that allows you to access the Pokémon storage system. There are some places where it won't work.

name: Wishing Star
flavor_text: A stone found in the Galar region with a mysterious power. It's said that your dreams come true if you find one.

name: Dynamax Band
flavor_text: A Wishing Star has been affixed to it. It lets out a light that allows Pokémon to Dynamax when at a Power Spot.

name: Fishing Rod
flavor_text: Use it by the water to fish up various kinds of Pokémon.

name: Rotom Bike
flavor_text: This bike can be combined with the Pokémon Rotom to use a turbo boost.

name: Sausages
flavor_text: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. These sausages should be boiled before eating.

name: Bob's Food Tin
flavor_text: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. The tinned food that Bob sells is curiously popular in Galar.

name: Bach's Food Tin
flavor_text: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. The tinned food that Bach sells is curiously popular in Galar.

name: Tin of Beans
flavor_text: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. When simmered, the beans suffuse a dish with their mild flavor.

name: Bread
flavor_text: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. An indispensable tool for mopping up that extra curry left on your plate.

name: Pasta
flavor_text: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. These flour noodles make for a surprisingly good match with curry.

name: Mixed Mushrooms
flavor_text: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. The chewy texture of the mushrooms transforms any dish they're added to.

name: Smoke-Poke Tail
flavor_text: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. When a Slowpoke's tail falls off, it grows back quickly.

name: Large Leek
flavor_text: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. Whether this is the kind of vegetable stalk that Farfetch'd like is unknown.

name: Fancy Apple
flavor_text: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. An apple chosen above others. It has spectacular form and a brilliant sheen.

name: Brittle Bones
flavor_text: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. The taste boiled off from the bones is sure to give a dish a light umami taste.

name: Pack of Potatoes
flavor_text: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. Potatoes help mellow out a spicy taste, to make a dish more mild.

name: Pungent Root
flavor_text: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. Though carelessly picked, these herbs can add a fragrant accent to a dish.

name: Salad Mix
flavor_text: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. The assortment of vegetables looks quite appealing and healthy.

name: Fried Food
flavor_text: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. It's been a while since it was fried, so it's gotten greasy.

name: Boiled Egg
flavor_text: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. Even just one boiled egg can really enhance a dish.

name: Camping Gear
flavor_text: Everything you need to set up a tent and get cooking in a Wild Area or at a camping spot.

name: Rusted Sword
flavor_text: It is said that a hero used this sword to halt a terrible disaster in ancient times. But it's grown rusty and worn.

name: Rusted Shield
flavor_text: It is said that a hero used this shield to halt a terrible disaster in ancient times. But it's grown rusty and worn.

name: Fossilized Bird
flavor_text: A fossil piece left behind by a prehistoric Pokémon that once soared through the sky. What it looked like is a mystery.

name: Fossilized Fish
flavor_text: A fossil piece left behind by a prehistoric Pokémon that once lived in the sea. What it looked like is a mystery.

name: Fossilized Drake
flavor_text: A fossil piece left behind by a prehistoric Pokémon that once roamed the land. What it looked like is a mystery.

name: Fossilized Dino
flavor_text: A fossil piece left behind by a prehistoric Pokémon that once lived in the sea. What it looked like is a mystery.

name: Tart Apple

name: Eject Pack
flavor_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If the holder's stats are lowered, it will be switched out of battle.

name: Heavy-Duty Boots
flavor_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. These boots protect the holder from the effects of traps and the like set on the battlefield.

name: Blunder Policy
flavor_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If the holder misses with a move due to low accuracy, this policy will sharply boost its Speed stat.

name: Room Service
flavor_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If Trick Room takes effect, this item will lower the holder's Speed stat.

name: Utility Umbrella
flavor_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This sturdy umbrella protects the holder from the effects of rain and harsh sunlight.

name: Exp. Candy XS
flavor_text: A candy that is packed with energy. If consumed, it grants a Pokémon a very small number of Exp. Points.

name: Exp. Candy S
flavor_text: A candy that is packed with energy. If consumed, it grants a Pokémon a small number of Exp. Points.

name: Exp. Candy M
flavor_text: A candy that is packed with energy. If consumed, it grants a Pokémon a moderate number of Exp. Points.

name: Exp. Candy L
flavor_text: A candy that is packed with energy. If consumed, it grants a Pokémon a large number of Exp. Points.

name: Exp. Candy XL
flavor_text: A candy that is packed with energy. If consumed, it grants a Pokémon a very large number of Exp. Points.

name: Dynamax Candy
flavor_text: A candy that is packed with energy. If consumed, it raises the Dynamax Level of a Pokémon by one. A higher level means higher HP when Dynamaxed.

name: TR00
flavor_text: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. This sharply raises the user's Attack stat.

name: TR01
flavor_text: The user drops onto the target with its full body weight. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

name: TR02
flavor_text: The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.

name: TR03
flavor_text: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.

name: TR04
flavor_text: The user attacks everything around it by swamping its surroundings with a giant wave.

name: TR05
flavor_text: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. This may also leave the target frozen.

name: TR06
flavor_text: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike opposing Pokémon. This may also leave the opposing Pokémon frozen.

name: TR07
flavor_text: A powerful low kick that makes the target fall over. The heavier the target, the greater the move's power.

name: TR08
flavor_text: A strong electric blast crashes down on the target. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

name: TR09
flavor_text: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

name: TR10
flavor_text: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every Pokémon around it.

name: TR11
flavor_text: The target is hit by a strong telekinetic force. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

name: TR12
flavor_text: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This sharply raises the Speed stat.

name: TR13
flavor_text: The user takes a deep breath and focuses so that critical hits land more easily.

name: TR14
flavor_text: The user waggles a finger and stimulates its brain into randomly using nearly any move.

name: TR15
flavor_text: The target is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.

name: TR16
flavor_text: The user charges at the target and may make it flinch.

name: TR17
flavor_text: The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its concerns. This sharply raises the user's Sp. Def stat.

name: TR18
flavor_text: The user drains the target's blood. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

name: TR19
flavor_text: The user strikes with a simultaneous three-beam attack. This may also burn, freeze, or paralyze the target.

name: TR20
flavor_text: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its own HP. The substitute serves as the user's decoy.

name: TR21
flavor_text: An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.

name: TR22
flavor_text: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. This may also poison the target.

name: TR23
flavor_text: The user lays a trap of spikes at the opposing team's feet. The trap hurts Pokémon that switch into battle.

name: TR24
flavor_text: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.

name: TR25
flavor_text: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This attack does physical damage.

name: TR26
flavor_text: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

name: TR27
flavor_text: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

name: TR28
flavor_text: Using its tough and impressive horn, the user rams into the target with no letup.

name: TR29
flavor_text: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting and passes along any stat changes.

name: TR30
flavor_text: The user compels the target to keep using the move it encored for three turns.

name: TR31
flavor_text: The target is slammed with a steel-hard tail. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.

name: TR32
flavor_text: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.

name: TR33

name: TR34

name: TR35
flavor_text: The user attacks in an uproar for three turns. During that time, no Pokémon can fall asleep.

name: TR36
flavor_text: The user attacks by exhaling hot breath on opposing Pokémon. This may also leave those Pokémon with a burn.

name: TR37
flavor_text: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for three turns.

name: TR38
flavor_text: The user catches the target off guard and swaps its held item with its own.

name: TR39
flavor_text: The user attacks the target with great power. However, this also lowers the user's Attack and Defense stats.

name: TR40
flavor_text: The user employs its psychic power to exchange Abilities with the target.

name: TR41
flavor_text: The user launches a kick that lands a critical hit more easily. This may also leave the target with a burn.

name: TR42
flavor_text: The user lets loose a horribly echoing shout with the power to inflict damage.

name: TR43
flavor_text: The user attacks the target at full power. The attack's recoil harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.

name: TR44
flavor_text: The user absorbs a mystical power from space to raise its Defense and Sp. Def stats.

name: TR45
flavor_text: The user attacks by shooting muddy water at opposing Pokémon. This may also lower their accuracy.

name: TR46
flavor_text: The user hardens its body's surface like iron, sharply raising its Defense stat.

name: TR47
flavor_text: The user slashes the target with huge sharp claws.

name: TR48
flavor_text: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, raising both its Attack and Defense stats.

name: TR49
flavor_text: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to raise its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

name: TR50
flavor_text: The user handles a sharp leaf like a sword and attacks by cutting its target. Critical hits land more easily.

name: TR51
flavor_text: The user vigorously performs a mystic, powerful dance that raises its Attack and Speed stats.

name: TR52
flavor_text: The user tackles the target with a high-speed spin. The slower the user compared to the target, the greater the move's power.

name: TR53
flavor_text: The user fights the target up close without guarding itself. This also lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def stats.

name: TR54
flavor_text: The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team. The spikes will poison opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.

name: TR55
flavor_text: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges the target. This also damages the user quite a lot. This attack may leave the target with a burn.

name: TR56
flavor_text: The user lets loose a blast of aura power from deep within its body at the target. This attack never misses.

name: TR57
flavor_text: The target is stabbed with a tentacle, arm, or the like steeped in poison. This may also poison the target.

name: TR58
flavor_text: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with dark thoughts. This may also make the target flinch.

name: TR59
flavor_text: The user slams a barrage of hard-shelled seeds down on the target from above.

name: TR60
flavor_text: The user slashes at the target by crossing its scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors.

name: TR61
flavor_text: The user generates a damaging sound wave by vibration. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

name: TR62
flavor_text: The target is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user's gaping mouth.

name: TR63
flavor_text: The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as if it were made of gemstones.

name: TR64
flavor_text: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

name: TR65
flavor_text: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

name: TR66
flavor_text: The user tucks in its wings and charges from a low altitude. This also damages the user quite a lot.

name: TR67
flavor_text: The user makes the ground under the target erupt with power. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

name: TR68
flavor_text: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. This sharply raises the user's Sp. Atk stat.

name: TR69
flavor_text: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the target. This may also make the target flinch.

name: TR70
flavor_text: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it all at once. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

name: TR71
flavor_text: The user whips up a storm of leaves around the target. The attack's recoil harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.

name: TR72
flavor_text: The user violently whirls its vines, tentacles, or the like to harshly lash the target.

name: TR73
flavor_text: The user shoots filthy garbage at the target to attack. This may also poison the target.

name: TR74
flavor_text: The user slams the target with its steel-hard head. This may also make the target flinch.

name: TR75
flavor_text: The user stabs the target from below with sharpened stones. Critical hits land more easily.

name: TR76
flavor_text: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the opposing team. The trap hurts opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.

name: TR77
flavor_text: The user snares the target with grass and trips it. The heavier the target, the greater the move's power.

name: TR78
flavor_text: The user strikes everything around it by swamping the area with a giant sludge wave. This may also poison those hit.

name: TR79
flavor_text: The user slams into the target with its heavy body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater the move's power.

name: TR80
flavor_text: The user hurls an electric orb at the target. The faster the user is than the target, the greater the move's power.

name: TR81
flavor_text: The user turns the target's power against it. The higher the target's Attack stat, the greater the damage it deals.

name: TR82
flavor_text: The user attacks the target with stored power. The more the user's stats are raised, the greater the move's power.

name: TR83
flavor_text: The user teleports using a strange power and switches places with one of its allies.

name: TR84
flavor_text: The user shoots boiling hot water at its target. This may also leave the target with a burn.

name: TR85
flavor_text: The user is roused, and its Attack and Sp. Atk stats increase.

name: TR86
flavor_text: The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes into its target. This also damages the user a little.

name: TR87
flavor_text: The user crashes into its target while rotating its body like a drill. Critical hits land more easily.

name: TR88
flavor_text: The user slams its target with its flame-covered body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater the move's power.

name: TR89
flavor_text: The user attacks by wrapping its opponent in a fierce wind that flies up into the sky. This may also confuse the target.

name: TR90
flavor_text: The user plays rough with the target and attacks it. This may also lower the target's Attack stat.

name: TR91
flavor_text: Opposing Pokémon are drenched in an odd poisonous liquid. This lowers the Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats of a poisoned target.

name: TR92
flavor_text: The user damages opposing Pokémon by emitting a powerful flash.

name: TR93
flavor_text: The user swings both arms and hits the target. The target's stat changes don't affect this attack's damage.

name: TR94
flavor_text: The user fiercely attacks the target using its entire body.

name: TR95
flavor_text: The user attacks the target's throat, and the resultant suffering prevents the target from using moves that emit sound for two turns.

name: TR96
flavor_text: The user attacks the enemy with a pollen puff that explodes. If the target is an ally, it gives the ally a pollen puff that restores its HP instead.

name: TR97
flavor_text: The user bites the target with its psychic capabilities. This can also destroy Light Screen and Reflect.

name: TR98
flavor_text: The user slams into the target using a full-force blast of water. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.

name: TR99

flavor_text: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. The syrupy fruits give off a strong tropical feel.

name: Moomoo Cheese

name: Spice Mix

name: Fresh Cream

name: Packaged Curry

name: Coconut Milk
flavor_text: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. The refined sweetness of this coconut milk makes it quite popular.

name: Instant Noodles
flavor_text: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. It has a junk-food sort of taste, but it goes well with curry.

name: Precooked Burger
flavor_text: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. If you're unsure about what to cook, you can't go wrong with some burger.

name: Gigantamix
flavor_text: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. A mysterious spice. Even a tiny sprinkle is sure to make a curry gigantic.

name: Wishing Chip
flavor_text: Toss a number of them into a Pokémon Den for the chance to attract a wild Dynamax Pokémon.

name: Rotom Bike
flavor_text: This bike can be combined with the Pokémon Rotom to not only do a turbo boost but also run on the water.

name: Catching Charm
flavor_text: Having one of these mysterious, unshakable charms makes it more likely you'll get a critical catch.

name: Old Letter
flavor_text: A letter entrusted to you by a girl, to be delivered to a boy. Strangely, it looks old to you.

name: Band Autograph
flavor_text: It's signed by all members of the Galar region's most charismatic band, the Maximizers.

name: Sonia's Book
flavor_text: Professor Sonia's published writings. Her new discoveries about the Galar region's legends are recorded in this enjoyable read.

name: Rotom Catalog

name: Max Honey
flavor_text: Honey that Dynamax Vespiquen produces. Adding this honey to Max Soup makes the taste very smooth. It also has the same effect as a Max Revive.

name: Max Mushrooms
flavor_text: Mushrooms that have the power of changing Dynamax forms. They boost all stats of a Pokémon during battle.

name: Galarica Twig
flavor_text: A twig from a species of tree called Galarica that grows in certain areas around the Galar region. It's a material for an accessory for a certain Pokémon.

name: Galarica Cuff
flavor_text: A cuff made from woven-together Galarica Twigs. Giving it to a Galarian Slowpoke makes the Pokémon very happy.

name: Style Card
flavor_text: Having one of these cards increases the selection available to you in boutiques and hair salons.

name: Armor Pass
flavor_text: A pass to go to the Isle of Armor. Show it to the rail staff at Wedgehurst Station.

name: Rotom Bike
flavor_text: This bike can do a turbo boost and run on the water using Rotom's power. It's a sparkling white that shines brilliantly.

name: Rotom Bike
flavor_text: This bike can do a turbo boost and run on the water using Rotom's power. It's a glistening black that shines reddish-black.

name: Exp. Charm
flavor_text: Having one of these charms increases the Exp. Points your Pokémon get. It's a strange, stretchy charm that encourages growth.

name: Armorite Ore
flavor_text: Rare ore that can be obtained on the Isle of Armor. Something good will happen if you give it to a collector on the Isle of Armor.

name: Mark Charm
flavor_text: Having one of these mysterious and unique charms makes it more likely you'll encounter a Pokémon with a mark.

name: Reins of Unity
flavor_text: Reins that people presented to the king. They enhance Calyrex's power over bountiful harvests and unite Calyrex with its beloved steed.

name: Reins of Unity
flavor_text: Reins that people presented to the king. They enable those who are connected to communicate with each other. The reins separate Calyrex and its beloved steed.

name: Galarica Wreath
flavor_text: A wreath made from woven-together Galarica Twigs. Placing it on the head of a Galarian Slowpoke makes the Pokémon very happy.

name: Legendary Clue 1
flavor_text: A clue about the King of Bountiful Harvests. It's written by Peony, and an old photo is attached to it.

name: Legendary Clue 2
flavor_text: A clue about the legend of giants. It's written by Peony and has unique drawings.

name: Legendary Clue 3
flavor_text: A clue about the legend of bird Pokémon. It's written by Peony and has a unique drawing.

name: Legendary Clue?
flavor_text: A mysterious clue that Peony seems to have dropped. There's a photo attached to it showing a shining hole opening above the Max Lair.

name: Crown Pass
flavor_text: A pass to go to the Crown Tundra. Show it to the rail staff at Wedgehurst Station.

name: Wooden Crown
flavor_text: A mysterious object made of wood. Part of it seems to be chipped. Maybe it's meant to be part of something.

name: Radiant Petal
flavor_text: A single petal that the King of Bountiful Harvests gave you. It radiates faint light.

name: White Mane Hair
flavor_text: Mane hair that belonged to the King of Bountiful Harvests' beloved steed, Glastrier. The hair is strong and very flexible.

name: Black Mane Hair
flavor_text: Mane hair that belonged to the King of Bountiful Harvests' beloved steed, Spectrier. The hair is very smooth to the touch.

name: Iceroot Carrot
flavor_text: Produce that the King of Bountiful Harvests' beloved steed likes to eat. It grew in a field covered in snow.

name: Shaderoot Carrot
flavor_text: Produce that the King of Bountiful Harvests' beloved steed likes to eat. It grew in a gloomy field.

name: Dynite Ore
flavor_text: Mysterious ore that can be obtained in the Max Lair. Something good will happen if you give it to a collector in the Crown Tundra.

name: Carrot Seeds
flavor_text: Seeds to plant in a field. The kind of carrot you'll get is determined by which field you plant the seeds in.

name: Ability Patch
flavor_text: A patch that can be used to change the regular Ability of a Pokémon to a rarer Ability.

name: Reins of Unity
flavor_text: Cords that shine when you hold them up to the light. The people of old times presented these to the King of Bountiful Harvests to express their gratitude.

name: Adamant Crystal
flavor_text: An item to be held by Dialga. This large, glowing gem wells with power and allows the Pokémon to change form.

name: Lustrous Globe
flavor_text: An item to be held by Palkia. This large, glowing orb wells with power and allows the Pokémon to change form.

name: Griseous Core
flavor_text: An item to be held by Giratina. This large, glowing gem wells with power and allows the Pokémon to change form.

name: Blank Plate
flavor_text: A stone tablet imbued with the essence of normalcy. When used on a certain Pokémon, it allows that Pokémon to gain the power of the Normal type.

name: Legend Plate
flavor_text: A stone tablet imbued with the essence of all creation. When used on a certain Pokémon, it allows that Pokémon to gain the power of every type there is.

name: Rotom Phone
flavor_text: The latest model of smartphone. A Pokémon called Rotom lives within it, and it can be used to run all sorts of handy apps.

name: Sandwich
flavor_text: A dish made by sandwiching vegetables, meat, or other ingredients between two pieces of bread. It makes a fantastic meal when out on a picnic.

name: Koraidon's Poké Ball
flavor_text: A Poké Ball that can hold the mysterious Pokémon known as Koraidon. A boy named Arven gave it to you.

name: Miraidon's Poké Ball
flavor_text: A Poké Ball that can hold the mysterious Pokémon known as Miraidon. A boy named Arven gave it to you.

name: Tera Orb
flavor_text: An orb that holds within it the power to crystallize. When it is charged with energy, it can be used to cause Pokémon to Terastallize.

name: Scarlet Book
flavor_text: A record of the expedition that the author, Heath, went on within the Great Crater of Paldea. The book has the name “Sada” written on it in clumsy handwriting.

name: Violet Book
flavor_text: A record of the expedition that the author, Heath, went on within the Great Crater of Paldea. The book has the name “Turo” written on it in clumsy handwriting.

name: Kofu's Wallet
flavor_text: A wallet that was left behind by Kofu, the Gym Leader at the Cascarrafa Gym. You're to deliver it to him at the market in Porto Marinada.

name: Tiny Bamboo Shoot
flavor_text: A small and rare bamboo shoot. It's quite popular with a certain class of gourmands.

name: Big Bamboo Shoot
flavor_text: A large and rare bamboo shoot. It's extremely popular with a certain class of gourmands.

name: Scroll of Darkness
flavor_text: A peculiar scroll that can make a certain species of Pokémon evolve. Written upon it are the true secrets of the path of darkness.

name: Scroll of Waters
flavor_text: A peculiar scroll that can make a certain species of Pokémon evolve. Written upon it are the true secrets of the path of water.

name: Malicious Armor
flavor_text: A peculiar set of armor that can make a certain species of Pokémon evolve. Malicious will lurks within it.

name: Booster Energy
flavor_text: An item to be held by Pokémon with certain Abilities. The energy that fills this capsule boosts the strength of the Pokémon.

name: Ability Shield
flavor_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This cute and rather unique-looking shield protects the holder from having its Ability changed by others.

name: Clear Amulet
flavor_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This clear, sparkling amulet protects the holder from having its stats lowered by moves used against it or by other Pokémon's Abilities.

name: Mirror Herb
flavor_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This herb will allow the holder to mirror an opponent's stat increases to boost its own stats—but only once.

name: Punching Glove
flavor_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This protective glove boosts the power of the holder's punching moves and prevents direct contact with targets.

name: Covert Cloak
flavor_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This hooded cloak conceals the holder, tricking the eyes of its enemies and protecting it from the additional effects of moves.

name: Loaded Dice
flavor_text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This loaded dice always rolls a good number, and holding one can ensure that the holder's multistrike moves hit more times.

name: Baguette
flavor_text: A long loaf sliced into top and bottom halves. Its aroma of wheat and its straightforward, salty flavor make it pair well with all kinds of sandwich ingredients.

name: Mayonnaise
flavor_text: A condiment that packs a very tart punch yet pairs well with various ingredients.

name: Ketchup
flavor_text: A condiment with very salty and tart flavor. While a number of other ingredients go into its signature flavor, the noble tomato is its heart and soul.

name: Mustard
flavor_text: A very spicy condiment that's indispensable when bread is on the table. It pairs tremendously with ketchup.

name: Butter
flavor_text: A condiment that unites salty and sweet and also packs a richness that makes bread a delight to eat. The finest butter products are made of 100 percent Moomoo Milk.

name: Peanut Butter
flavor_text: A very sweet condiment. People in Paldea seem to favor the sweet varieties over the unsweetened.

name: Chili Sauce
flavor_text: A condiment with a very spicy kick. It's thanks to Scovillain that this sauce gets its signature mouth- tingling burn.

name: Salt
flavor_text: A very salty seasoning, unsurprisingly. People quite like the grains of salt that can be gathered from the footprints of particularly jagged Naclstack.

name: Pepper
flavor_text: A seasoning packing very spicy flavor. It goes nicely with oilier foods and works especially well when you add just a pinch for a hint of flavor.

name: Yogurt
flavor_text: A condiment that's very sweet and very sour. It goes especially well with fruit and is easy to incorporate into a sandwich.

name: Whipped Cream
flavor_text: A very sweet condiment. Folks in Paldea seem to love the varieties that really let the sweetness sing.

name: Cream Cheese
flavor_text: A condiment offering very sweet and very tart flavor. It goes well with more ingredients than you'd expect, making it a convenient go-to.

name: Jam
flavor_text: A condiment that's very sweet and likewise very sour. Take care when adding it to sandwiches, as the sweet side can overwhelm.

name: Marmalade
flavor_text: A condiment with sour and bitter notes. It's surprisingly useful, as it makes a nice counterpoint to oilier foods.

name: Olive Oil
flavor_text: A condiment offering faint notes of sour and bitter flavors. The most prized varieties are the ones Smoliv love the smell of—such oils' quality is assured.

name: Vinegar
flavor_text: A very sour condiment. Vinegars derived from grapes are popular in Paldea. Highly effective when used to add just a light note of flavor.

name: Sweet Herba Mystica
flavor_text: A legendary condiment told of only in books. Word has it that one taste of its sweet flavor stimulates the digestive system and cures a lack of appetite.

name: Salty Herba Mystica
flavor_text: One of the condiments spoken of as legends. Its mellow saltiness is said to be tremendously effective when it comes to promoting health.

name: Sour Herba Mystica
flavor_text: This surpassingly sour condiment is said to be super effective in helping the eater recover from exhaustion. Only a scant few people know it exists.

name: Bitter Herba Mystica
flavor_text: A legendary condiment with a deeply bitter taste. It's said to dramatically bolster a body's immune defenses, though that hasn't been proven.

name: Spicy Herba Mystica
flavor_text: The legendary condiment said to have the mightiest of all spicy flavors. It's said that a single bite will kick the metabolism into high gear immediately.

name: Lettuce
flavor_text: This bitter-tasting ingredient is simple and straightforward—just add it to all kinds of other ingredients for a delightfully crunchy time.

name: Tomato
flavor_text: This very tart ingredient has a lot of savory elements to it, making it popular with many Pokémon.

name: Cherry Tomatoes
flavor_text: A very tart ingredient. Some varieties are also very sweet, and these are prized above all others by the people of Paldea.

name: Cucumber
flavor_text: A tart and bitter ingredient. Using it together with rich- tasting ingredients in a sandwich will really make the most of a cucumber's fresh-veggie aroma.

name: Pickle
flavor_text: This very sour ingredient is made by pickling veggies in a flavorful brine made from spices and vinegar.

name: Onion
flavor_text: This spicy veggie is indispensable to many sandwiches. It goes well with rich ingredients.

name: Red Onion
flavor_text: An ingredient with some sweetness to it. Its spiciness and fragrance are milder than those of other onions, making it a pleasant bite.

name: Green Bell Pepper
flavor_text: An ingredient with some bitterness. When sliced, it adds a nice accent to a sandwich.

name: Red Bell Pepper
flavor_text: An ingredient with some bitterness—but its bitter notes and overall flavor are pleasantly mild compared to its green cousin.

name: Yellow Bell Pepper
flavor_text: An ingredient with some bitterness. It's not much different from its red counterpart in flavor, but mixing the colors makes a feast for the eyes.

name: Avocado
flavor_text: An ingredient with sweet notes—though its flavor is very mild. The avocado's richness, however, makes it satisfying to eat.

name: Bacon
flavor_text: This very salty ingredient has been cooked just shy of charred, making it burst with fragrance and tasty flavor.

name: Ham
flavor_text: A very salty ingredient—and that very saltiness is what makes it such a nice companion to veggies.

name: Prosciutto
flavor_text: This ingredient is very salty like regular ham, but the difference is prosciutto is not cooked after it is cured, giving it a fun freshness.

name: Chorizo
flavor_text: A very salty and spicy ingredient. This type of sausage has particularly robust salty flavor, and the spicier varieties are extra popular.

name: Herbed Sausage
flavor_text: A very salty and bitter ingredient. The balance between the potent saltiness and the herbs' bitterness make this sausage a pleasure.

name: Hamburger
flavor_text: This very salty ingredient is the thing to add if you want to make your sandwich truly filling.

name: Klawf Stick
flavor_text: A very sweet and salty ingredient. It's a nutritious processed food made with a concentrate derived from shed Klawf shells.

name: Smoked Fillet
flavor_text: A very salty and bitter ingredient with that unmistakable smoky flavor. It pairs exceptionally well with veggies.

name: Fried Fillet
flavor_text: When used in a sandwich, this very salty and bitter ingredient is at its best paired with sour seasonings.

name: Egg
flavor_text: An ingredient with a touch of saltiness. It's full of nutrients and can be enjoyed with all sorts of seasonings.

name: Potato Tortilla
flavor_text: A very salty ingredient and a popular dish in Paldea. It's undeniably filling.

name: Tofu
flavor_text: An ingredient with a touch of sweetness. It's unclear how well this raw block of tofu will serve as a sandwich filling.

name: Rice
flavor_text: An ingredient with a touch of sweetness. It's unclear how well this cooked rice will serve as a sandwich filling.

name: Noodles
flavor_text: A nice salty ingredient. It's unclear how well these boiled noodles will serve as a sandwich filling.

name: Potato Salad
flavor_text: This very tart ingredient—a soft salad that's all about potatoes—pairs tremendously well with bread.

name: Cheese
flavor_text: A very salty ingredient. This thinly sliced cheese is perfect for adding to a sandwich.

name: Banana
flavor_text: A very sweet ingredient. This go-to fruit is sweet and rich, and it's beloved by many Pokémon.

name: Strawberry
flavor_text: A very tart and sweet ingredient, popular for its ability to make a sandwich visually striking.

name: Apple
flavor_text: This very sweet ingredient is sliced thin to make it easy to add into a sandwich.

name: Kiwi
flavor_text: A very tart ingredient that has a light touch of sweetness as well. It goes well with rich ingredients.

name: Pineapple
flavor_text: This very tart ingredient is a fruit of southern lands, and its color and texture are a thrill. It's been cut into chunks to be easily manageable.

name: Jalapeño
flavor_text: A very spicy ingredient—so spicy as to leave no room for ambivalence about it. You either like it or you don't.

name: Horseradish
flavor_text: A very spicy condiment. Its distinctive sharp sizzle in your sinuses makes it a good match for rich fillings.

name: Curry Powder
flavor_text: A very spicy condiment. Just watch out—use too much of this potent seasoning, and it'll cancel out the other flavors.

name: Wasabi
flavor_text: This very spicy condiment seems close to horseradish at first, but you'll find that it has a superb flavor all its own.

name: Watercress
flavor_text: A very bitter ingredient that stands out among veggies for its quirky flavor. People tend to either like it or not like it—they rarely sit on the fence.

name: Basil
flavor_text: A very bitter ingredient that's quite versatile, as herbs go. It's fragrant and goes well with tomatoes.
